# Startup readback: AI-19

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Build one redacted observability substrate across a representative user-visible workflow. Acceptance: one correlation ID joins its run, queue attempt, AI/tool calls, evidence, report and result; immutable audit and typed provenance/freshness records can be queried deterministically; sensitive values stay out of routine traces, with large payload archival metadata queryable when R2 archival is in scope.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-14, AI-15, AI-18 and AI-65 are Done. AI-14 PR #163 established `evidenceReferenceSchema`/`evidenceLinkSchema` and canonical run/evidence records; its completion note records local contract/ACL/DB proofs and staging create/read/transition acceptance. AI-15 PR #165 merged with `workflow_runs.correlation_id`, orchestrator stages, trace writes and validated report path; its completion note records `verify:changed`, staging deterministic plus bounded Responses runs, and production smoke. AI-18 PR #166 owns durable queue attempts and correlation-linked lifecycle events; its lease regression is `supabase/tests/queue_lease_ownership.sql`. AI-65 is Done with staging/production private R2 canary readiness in `docs/build/prerequisite-manifest.md`; it does not prove an application archive round-trip. Build Spec §§2.3, 7.7, 9, 10, 11.4 govern provenance, immutable audit, classification, retention and trace/freshness data; Agent Spec §1.1 assigns platform tracing/freshness to Systems; Frontend Constitution §§16–17 and 36.1–36.3 require summaries-first runs, expandable evidence and visible stale/unknown states. AI-16 owns prompt/model/schema/tool policy registries and capability evaluations; AI-19 may record those version IDs in trace metadata but must not define or change their selection/promotion contracts.

## Implementation and boundaries

Current anchors are `packages/observability/src/index.ts` (`redactTraceFields`, currently key-only), `packages/contracts/src/evidence.ts` (`evidenceReferenceSchema`/`evidenceLinkSchema`), and foundation tables `workflow_runs.correlation_id`, `trace_events`, `audit_events`, and `data_freshness` in `supabase/migrations/202608020001_foundation.sql`. Producers include `supabase/functions/_shared/agent-runtime-diagnostics.ts`, `supabase/functions/ai-execute/handler.ts`, queue completion/dispatch functions, and lifecycle SQL in `202608030001_platform_engine.sql`; existing evidence writes use the AI-14 contracts. Add canonical trace/event, redaction, immutable-audit and freshness contracts, persist and query them through authenticated existing service/data-access patterns, and instrument a complete launch→claim→execute→report workflow before shared producers. Keep sensitive raw payloads out of normal Postgres/log traces; put full payloads in private R2 only after approved redaction/encryption and retain queryable metadata. Do not redesign manager reasoning, prompt governance, queue semantics, user-facing Operations screens, or provider business logic owned by AI-16/18 and downstream AI-48/54.

## Local tests and commands

Add focused tests beside `packages/observability/src/index.test.ts` for nested values, unsafe strings, key/value-based sensitive data and fail-closed defaults; extend contract tests beside `packages/contracts/src/evidence.ts` for source/freshness provenance and trace event serialization. Add SQL coverage for append-only audit, owner isolation, correlation joins, freshness transitions and archive metadata beside `supabase/tests/agent_runtime_contracts.sql`/relevant AI-15 SQL tests. Inner loop: `corepack pnpm --filter @ai-operations/observability test`; run only the chosen observability SQL contract with `corepack pnpm exec supabase test db --local <test-file>`; final local gate: `corepack pnpm verify:changed`. The initial readback proof is `node infrastructure/scripts/ticket-readback.mjs check AI-19`.

## Hosted proof and readiness

AI-65 confirms isolated staging/production R2 canary access and AI-15 has completed canonical hosted workflows, but neither is AI-19 evidence. AI-19 requires one real staging workflow and a single correlation ID followed through the hosted boundaries it actually crosses to its visible result. Add a real source-sync/freshness transition only if implementation changes that provider boundary; add one R2 archive round-trip only if archival is materially changed. Before requesting staging, prove the selected fixtures, DB application-role/RPC/column grants, and acceptance-evidence producer→validator→consumer contract locally; retain the existing exact-candidate release and manual MFA gates. Do not repeat the AI-15 model/cost, AI-18 lease, or redaction failure matrices live.

## Delegation and blockers

No subagents: AI-19 has one implementation owner, and the repository/issue explicitly discourage reviewer panels. Coordinate the trace metadata boundary with the active AI-16 owner before changing any shared AI call/run columns or migrations; AI-16 owns version policy/evals, AI-19 owns correlation, trace/audit, evidence and freshness semantics. Serena initial instructions were read and this worktree was activated, but its language server reports none; use `rg`, installed types and `docs/engineering/repo-map.generated.md`. Repository `ai-operations-investigate` and Ponytail skills are available and applied; Context7 is available but unnecessary for current local contracts. No hosted/browser blocker is established for readback; the bounded staging slot, user MFA and conditional R2 boundary remain future prerequisites.
